item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 5:55 AM, 24 August 2026(Monday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan(Morong, Bagac, Mariveles, Limay, Orion) and Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Angeles, Mabalacat) within the next 2 hours.

Heavy to intense rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in Zambales(Botolan, Iba, Palauig, Masinloc, Candelaria, Santa Cruz) and Tarlac(Mayantoc, San Jose, Capas) which may persist within 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
